description: This is a test class for the LicenseService component within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing license-related functionalities such as retrieving, deleting, and fetching licenses by ID or name. It contains mock setups for dependencies and assertions to verify expected behavior.

classes.name: LicenseServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LicenseService functions such as retrieving, deleting, and fetching licenses from the data source using mock dependencies.

methods.name: testGetLicenseList
methods.description: Tests that the LicenseService correctly retrieves a list of licenses based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteLicenses
methods.description: Verifies that the deletion of licenses via LicenseService invokes the DAO correctly and returns the expected number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetLicenseById
methods.description: Checks if obtaining a license by ID returns the correct License object.

methods.name: testGetLicenseByName
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving a license by name functions as expected.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, setting up LicenseService instance and loading test data.
